issues.message: Only 3/28 source notes (11%) have breadcrumbs — the guided reading loop did not fire. The initial batch fetch is not the whole corpus; after fetching seeds you MUST spawn analysts to propose next targets, then fetch those with `--suggested-by`. Target: at least 30% of sources should come from analyst recommendations.

Vault has 28 fetched source notes but only 0 real source-linked extract notes (0% coverage, need ≥9). The analyst was skipped on most sources or the source->extract chain of custody is broken. Spawn an analyst subagent on the unanalyzed sources during curation. Target: at least 1 extract (≥150 words, with `parent=<source-note-id>`) per 3 sources (floor of 1 for any corpus size). Minting stub notes to pass this gate is lint-gaming and will not satisfy.

6 atomic entity/entities from prompt-decomposition.json are missing from the final report: Titanium aluminides (γ-TiAl), Refractory alloying elements (rhenium, tungsten, molybdenum, tantalum, niobium, ruthenium), Gamma-prime (γ′/γ'') precipitates, Single-crystal and directionally-solidified castings, Thermal barrier coatings (YSZ), Internal film and convective cooling. The draft drifted from the user's explicit ask. Re-spawn the instruction-critic with the missing items flagged, or hand-craft Edits to restore them.

Required format(s) from prompt-decomposition not visibly present in draft: comparison table of alloy systems (base metal, representative grades, service temperature), per-mechanism bulleted explanations for heat tolerance. This may be a false positive if the format is rendered without the spec word in the prose — review manually.
